purpose: Binary evidence for the boxing_pose_detector experiment, versioned through Git LFS. The standalone source repository PedroM2626/boxing-pose-detector was deleted on 2026-10-15, which makes this directory the only copy of these files outside D:/boxing-pose-detector-archive-2026-10-15.bundle.
layout: Each model keeps the directory shape MLflow wrote under mlruns/1/models/<id>/artifacts/, so the folder itself is a loadable MLflow model directory: MLmodel, conda.yaml, python_env.yaml, requirements.txt and model.pkl. Only model.pkl and mlflow.db go through LFS; the descriptors are plain text.
how_to_load_a_model: mlflow.sklearn.load_model('experiments/artifacts/boxing_pose_detector_20260512_192700_419b421/model_artifacts/xgboost_best-m-193baba3c9db46f39776055a188dfc88') - note the recorded environment is Python 3.13.1 with scikit-learn 1.7.1, so loading it under the monorepo environment (3.11.9 / 1.4.2) is not guaranteed.

mlflow.db.content: MLflow SQLite backend: experiment 1 'boxing-pose-classification', 5 FINISHED runs, 5 accuracy metrics, 22 logged parameters. The metrics/ directories under mlruns/ were never committed, so this database is the authoritative record of what each run measured. The original project pointed MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI at it (see the experiment's .env.example).

xgboost_best-m-193baba3c9db46f39776055a1.role: the best_model_XGBoost logged by compare_models; byte-identical to the pose_classifier_model.pkl that the application loads at runtime

cross_check: Every accuracy above was independently derived from the committed confusion matrices (diagonal/80) before this database was opened, and all five match exactly. Both RandomForest runs also logged features_count = 19, which is what pins the 20-dimensional no-pose fallback in extract_features as a real defect rather than a misreading of the .npy shapes.
dataset_attribution_caveat: The runs do not log which .npy they trained on. Collections A and B are attributed to runs 7535870b and 6e292fe0 from the wall-clock order only: those runs started at 21:46:42Z and 21:58:02Z, seconds after the two saves at 21:46:33 and 21:57:53 local. The three compare_models runs are attributed to collection B because 6e292fe0's RandomForest matrix is identical to the comparison's RandomForest matrix, which only happens on the same data and split.
note_on_the_third_model: LightGBM's own pickle was never logged: compare_models only calls mlflow.sklearn.log_model for the winner, so the LightGBM arm survives as its confusion matrix and its mlflow.db metric row, not as a loadable model.
